_doc: Exact-surface table of the allowlist claim checker (build 4, BRAIN_MOAT_ALLOWLIST: fold to find, exact to accept). entities: slug -> the surface forms (research/runners/_moat_allowlist.surface_form) of the store names of the ONE Wikidata id that carries every store fact under that slug (row_ids), whose sanitize() is the slug, without Unicode Cf/Cc characters, plus each such form with ', ' written ' ', minus the de-slugged form. A slug with no row (multi_id_slugs, or no exception) accepts only the slug and its de-slugged form.
carrier_rule: an id carries a store fact under slug s when it is the subject (or object) of a training line whose (subject, relation, object) slugs are a store fact with s in that place
